provenance.who: a coding-agent session (the one that built the publisher), from the code and docs of the publisher and from content-blind measurements of its sheet on a mock Canvas in headless Chromium at 390x844 touch; nobody has used this flow on a phone
provenance.note: speeds-kit commit 70f8ef64105652b0c5b4fc5d1f9ba2b7c65a94ee, userscripts/draft-publish.user.js sha256 006ababa16052d59a2a09ac0a56b01b6a6430898030b405240ce165ee9a1ad43, 441 lines. Written BEFORE the owner's first run of the publisher, so this file is a prediction and not a record. The save-from-chat steps reuse the properties the owner STATED about HW1 (tapgrade_0_6_7_sample_pass.json, steps 2-7). Steps marked [guess] are not from anything the owner said; steps marked [declared] are judgments about what the screen says, made by the author of the publisher (P-02be: silence means nothing was declared wrong). The two Canvas-only chains (dp-manual-set, dp-manual-post) are the Gradebook routes the publisher's doc offers; they are written from the author's knowledge of Canvas, not from this owner.
